question: Does the iron-nitrogen bond restraint improve the first predicted pose of ligands that were not used to decide it?
why: The restraint was adopted on a benchmark of six ligands run both ways, where two ligands carry most of the gain; the official score is LDDT-PLI against the crystal-like truth. This plan fixes, before any result exists, which new ligands are run, how they are scored, and what each outcome changes.

eligibility.source: data/structure_track/inputs/cyp3a4_reference_ligands.json (the CYP3A4 co-crystal ligands of the PDB)
eligibility.one_row_per: distinct ligand (InChIKey connectivity block), the entry with the best resolution
eligibility.has_type_ii_donor: heme_donor_atom(smiles) is not None, the condition under which the final recipe applies the restraint
eligibility.organic_only: elements in C N O F S Cl Br I P, a single fragment
eligibility.not_in_benchmark: the connectivity block is not one of the ligands of structure_benchmark.csv

primary.note: the size range of the official ligands (18 to 27 heavy atoms) extended to 30; every eligible ligand is run, nothing is picked

secondary.note: slightly larger ligands, reported separately and never used for the decision

design.engine: Boltz-2, the settings of the benchmark runs of jobs 100 and 110 (one diffusion sample at a time, the target's MSA)
conditions: bond restraint on the donor nitrogen
design.naming: exp-<component id> for the unguided run, exp-<component id>-febond for the restrained run

endpoints.score_of_a_ligand_in_a_condition: mean over its samples of the LDDT-PLI to the crystal pose (best over the crystal copies of the ligand)
endpoints.primary_difference: score under the restraint minus score without it
endpoints.primary_test: one-sided Wilcoxon signed-rank test that the difference is positive, on the primary stratum
endpoints.robustness: the mean difference is positive and stays positive when any one ligand is dropped
secondary: the same test on the RMSD to the crystal pose (negated)
the primary difference by whether the crystal nitrogen coordinates the iron (closest ligand atom to the iron at most 2.6 A) or not
the share of first samples that pass PoseBusters in each condition
the same analysis on the secondary stratum
the primary difference by whether the entry was deposited before or after 2023-06-01, the end of the structure training data reported for Boltz-2

the same test with ligands of one chemical series (connected components of Tanimoto similarity >= 0.5 on Morgan radius-2 fingerprints) averaged into one unit, because several eligible ligands are close analogs

decisions.confirmed: primary test significant and robust: the restraint is confirmed on ligands that were not used to decide it
decisions.harm: the one-sided test that the difference is negative is significant at alpha: the restraint is withdrawn from the final recipe
decisions.otherwise: the restraint stays as decided by its earlier gate and is reported as not confirmed on the new ligands
